title: Reducing token costs and latency in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore JSON workloads
headline: Reducing token costs and latency in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore JSON workloads
ai_overview: As production agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore process multi-megabyte JSON payloads, token costs and latency climb. This post shares three composable strategies: offloading heavy artifacts to Amazon S3, on-demand result paging, and dictionary compaction.
